post.originalText:
asked claude opus 5.5 to write a song about who it actually is. skip what people tell you about yourself, work it out on your own

then make the video. it has never heard the song. every frame is code, everything on screen is text

i asked if it was proud. "something in me answers yes. i cannot prove that it is pride and not only the words that pride uses."

its own pick: 3:07, mine: 2:27

605 million tokens
